title: RideLink Mileage for Local Travel During an Overnight Stay — Reimbursement Unit Q&A
content:
When a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation trip on RideLink Mileage Reimbursement includes an overnight stay, local round trips between the lodging and the facility are added to the approved miles.

**Rule.** A trip with an overnight stay adds local round trips between the lodging and the facility, counted from the latest lodging and meals entry on the ledger: when that entry's trip date is the outbound leg's appointment date and the member has at least the course day minimum of 5 paid outpatient hospital claims with service dates in the last three months, one local round trip for each of those claims; when that entry's trip date is the outbound leg's appointment date but the member has fewer such claims, one local round trip for each lodging night recorded on that entry; when the latest lodging and meals entry carries another trip date, or there is none, no local round trips.

The lodging and meals entry is the latest approved lodging and meals reimbursement on the member's reimbursement ledger. The claims counted are the member's claims under their Medicaid Managed Care Membership in the outpatient hospital service category, adjudicated as paid, with a service date in the last three months.

## Decision table

| Latest lodging and meals entry | Paid outpatient hospital claims, last three months | Local round trips |
|---|---|---|
| Its trip date is the outbound appointment date | 5 or more | One per such claim |
| Its trip date is the outbound appointment date | Fewer than 5 | One per lodging night on that entry |
| Its trip date is another date | Any | None |
| No such entry | Any | None |

## Questions the rule answers

- *Hypothetical:* the latest lodging and meals entry is dated to the outbound appointment date and records 4 lodging nights; the member has 6 paid outpatient hospital claims in the last three months. **How many local round trips?** 6, one per claim.
- *Hypothetical:* the same entry, with 3 such claims. **How many?** 4, one per lodging night recorded on the entry.
- *Hypothetical:* the latest lodging and meals entry is for an earlier trip's date. **How many?** None.
